name_reason: Already compliant with the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention for a battle-core table (data_fd2_battle_*). The descriptor 'job_crit_rate_table' accurately reflects the contents (per-job critical-hit rate) and the data type (a table/array). No Ghidra address residue in the name; the only numbers in the conceptual model (job IDs 0x01..0x1A) are domain IDs, not part of the symbol name. Live Ghidra type is byte[27] and label matches byte-identically.
purpose: Per-job base critical-hit rate (in percent), indexed by job_id-1, seeding the crit roll in physical combat.
logic_summary: Two combat functions read this table as `data_fd2_battle_job_crit_rate_table[attacker.bJob_id - 1]` (MOVZX byte ptr [EAX + 0x5239B], unsigned, stride 1) to obtain the attacker's base crit percentage. That value becomes total_crit_pct (plus a weapon class-4 item bonus when present); after a successful hit roll the code rolls rng%100 < total_crit_pct, and on a crit halves the defender's DP before computing damage. job_id is 1-based so index 0 corresponds to job 0x01 (劍士); job 0x00 (龍/dragon) has no entry and is never used as an attacker job. Values verified against the strategy-guide crit table for all 26 jobs (e.g. 0x08 武者=18, 0x0C 狙擊手=12, 0x17 忍者=30).
element_semantics: Each byte = the base critical-hit chance (percent, 0..30) for one job. Element i holds the rate for job_id (i+1): indices 0..25 cover the 26 defined jobs 0x01..0x1A; index 26 (byte @ 0x523B5) is a trailing 0 pad not addressed by any job_id.
comment_original_issue: Existing src comment was mostly accurate but had two address inaccuracies in the final paragraph: it said the table is 'before zero padding at 0x523B2' (0x523B2 is actually job 0x18's real entry, index 23) and that the TAI.DAT string 'ends at 0x5239B' (the string's NUL is at 0x5239A; 0x5239B is where the table begins). The trailing in-array pad byte is index 26 @ 0x523B5, and the 3 alignment-pad bytes after the table start at 0x523B6 (before the next table @ 0x523B9).
notes: xrefs to 0x5239B are not tracked references (the reads use absolute-immediate form [EAX + 0x5239B], which Ghidra records as a constant operand, not a Reference); get_xrefs_to and the ReferenceManager scan both returned 0. Real readers found via search_instructions: fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation @ 0x1EE0C and fd2_calculate_combat_hit_outcome @ 0x2A0E5, both MOVZX (unsigned). No writers anywhere (is_const=true by game-side write-xref test). The src declaration carries a leading `const` but with a 'Non-const: ... seeded by test fixtures' banner comment; the storage type was left untouched per the no-logic-change rule. Sibling table data_fd2_battle_job_magic_resist_table @ 0x51F96 uses the same job_id-1 indexing.
